response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile software engineer, but his profile does not match the role's core requirements: his C++ experience is limited to a single ~6-month stint in 2014-2015 rather than the required 5-10 years, his recent career (2015-present) is almost entirely in web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) with no Windows C++ systems work, and there is no evidence of Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain exposure, nor SQL Server/Oracle depth.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated ability to work across many languages and paradigms (DLang, Node.js, TypeScript, C#, Java)
Fluent English communicator with public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months, over a decade ago) and not on the scale required (5-10 years)
No visible Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience
No strong SQL Server/Oracle experience noted; database background is mostly MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain exposure
Strong general engineering and communication skills
